text:
Unfortunately, I had to use the services of this urology clinic during my stay in Pattaya.

After my email inquiry, describing my problem, I immediately received an appointment for the next business day.

The clinic is clean and has exceptionally friendly staff.

It is clearly very well organized, as I only had to wait a short time after registering before I could speak with Dr. Niti.

Dr. Niti made a very good impression and was able to quickly help me with my "standard problem."

During the short wait, water, coffee, and small snacks are available free of charge.

If needed, I would come here again.

The consultation itself cost 1,000 THB.
